setup: This equation needs more than one move to isolate x.

steps.say: Whatever is attached to x must be undone by doing the opposite operation to *both* sides — subtracting the same number from each side is exactly what keeps them equal. Subtracting [[b]] leaves [[a]]x = [[ax]].
The brackets hide an addition. Divide both sides by [[a]] to peel them off first, which leaves x + [[b]] = [[inner]].
Subtracting [[b]] from both sides then leaves x standing alone.
Dividing through by the coefficient finishes it, giving x = [[x]].
